title: Encoded circuits compute their language
statement: Let $C$ be a family of Boolean directed acyclic circuits, one for each input length, and suppose every circuit in the family is well formed and has at most two arguments at each gate. For every bit string $x$, the evaluator on the encoding of the circuit for length $|x|$ paired with $x$ gives the indicator of the language accepted by the family on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a family of DAG circuits
every circuit in C has fan-in at most two and is well formed
